day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.message: The bulb's been blinking at you for weeks. Replace it this morning.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You against her, again. Drop the tally and go do yours.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Haul the coin jar to the machine today. Buy something stupid.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a trailer better than the film
signs.message: Two minutes had you sold. Watch the whole thing tonight anyway.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a person you keep almost calling
signs.message: You've rehearsed that call four times. Send two lines instead, today.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a slide deck at forty percent
signs.message: Half-built deck. Fix the titles, leave the rest till tomorrow.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Next time someone asks about your brother, brag a little.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the last day of a habit
signs.message: Last day of the streak. Do it once more, then stop.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Take the long way home on purpose. No stops, no errands.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You picked it last night. Wear exactly that, skip the debate.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a coin landing on its side
signs.message: The toss didn't settle it. Good, nothing needs deciding today.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the second option you keep going back to
signs.message: You keep scrolling back to the runner-up. Sleep on it again.
